submittedPrompt: 制作一张清晰三分区对照板，外部只标桌面、390px、320px，表示三个独立视口中的同一窗口，不是同页同时打开。全部字段/按钮保持可读，窄屏自然换行，允许内部滚动，关闭和主动作可达。只画明确列出的窗口与文案，不加附注或父页导航。平面白/浅灰、深色字、细线、小圆角、#4566c6蓝色、清晰紧凑中文；不画设备外壳。每份局部弹窗标题“按 Markdown 粘贴”、右上X；说明准确“粘贴 Markdown 后插入，标题、列表和代码块会转换为正文格式。暂不支持的语法会保留原文。”；label“Markdown 内容”；大textarea为空，显示placeholder“# 标题”空行“在这里粘贴 Markdown…”，此框只读不可编辑，保持正常只读样式，不增加只读标签或警告。底部“取消”可用，“插入 Markdown”灰色禁用。没有内容转换预览、粘贴源选择/保存/完成按钮或错误提示。窄屏大输入区可内部滚动，保留取消/主动作。

permissionRules: Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.

fields.name: Markdown 内容
fields.constraints: Nonblank; no explicit length cap in modal; conversion preserves unsupported syntax.

actions.label: 插入 Markdown
actions.effect: Convert supported syntax and insert at captured bookmark

actions.label: 取消
actions.guard: Owner session; control-specific guards described in permissionRules.

responsive.behavior: Ant Modal requests width620px; form children use width100% and scroll/height constraints where present. No caller-specific narrow-screen breakpoint was found; actual framework shrink/fit remains unverified.

sourceContracts.designReason: Existing user-visible surface requires baseline-aligned hierarchy, controls, feedback and responsive treatment without adding behavior.
notes: Source inventory only; no runtime behavior asserted.

postprocessing: Original built-in PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits.
